title: Photoshop: Non-destructive Scale, Rotate & Align with Smart Objects and Alignment Tools (Day 12)
summary: This 30 Days of Photoshop tutorial demonstrates a non-destructive workflow for scaling, rotating, and aligning layers. It starts with placing a stock image into a background frame as a Smart Object, then explores transform options (center vs corner pivot, alt/option-centered scaling, width/height linking), and uses keyboard modifiers to skew, perspective, and rotate. The lesson then shows masking a frame and adding an inner shadow for depth, followed by extracting a signature from a JPEG, converting it to a Smart Object, and using color range and fills to shape the result. The core focus culminates in alignment techniques: aligning multiple layers and aligning within selections using Photoshop’s Move tool and alignment controls, including converting layer masks to selections for precise placement. All steps illustrate a non-destructive approach with easily toggled visibility and editable transforms.
